subject: Proposed kickoff windows + host assignments — Acme Retail onboarding
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-01T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Proposed kickoff windows + host assignments — Acme Retail onboarding

Hi Sarah —

Great to be closing in on the kickoff. Attached is a short packet (Initial_Onboarding_Packet.pdf) with suggested prework and a draft agenda. Can you confirm which of these 90-minute windows works best for your team next week? I included times in PT below and the equivalent in ET.

Option A — Tue, Nov 9
- 09:00–10:30 PT (12:00–13:30 ET)
Option B — Wed, Nov 10
- 11:00–12:30 PT (14:00–15:30 ET)
Option C — Thu, Nov 11
- 13:00–14:30 PT (16:00–17:30 ET)

Proposed kickoff goals (90 mins):
- Introductions & success criteria (10m)
- Architecture & data flow review (25m)
- Integration checklist & responsibilities (20m)
- Ops runbook & SLOs (15m)
- Next steps + action owners (20m)

Internal hosts: Monica (CS lead), Marcus (infra/ops owner), Naomi (enablement). I can run the first 15m and close. If you can confirm the window and the attendee list (names + roles), I’ll send the calendar invite and include a Meet link.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Customer Operations | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: Initial_Onboarding_Packet.pdf (pdf)
From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme-retail.com>

Subject: Re: Proposed kickoff windows + host assignments — Acme Retail onboarding

Thanks Vanessa —

Option B (Wed Nov 10, 11:00–12:30 PT) works best for our core team. Confirmed attendees for the session:
- Sarah Lee — Head of Platform (host)
- Rajesh Patel — Data Engineering
- Elena Gomez — Security & Privacy
- Paul Meyer — Product (may be remote)

We’ll aim to have Paul join if his calendar clears; otherwise we’ll take notes for him. I’m attaching a simple attendee CSV with emails + timezones. Let us know who you want as the primary technical contact during the architecture section.

Best,
Sarah

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-11-03T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Proposed kickoff windows + host assignments — Acme Retail onboarding

Looping the delivery team so we can lock down owners.

Vanessa — thanks for coordinating. Per Sarah's pick (Wed Nov 10, Option B), propose the following host/owner assignments:
- Introductions & success criteria: Vanessa (customer ops) + Sarah (customer co-host)
- Architecture & data flow review: Marcus Lin (Infra/Integrations) — lead; Naomi to cover security controls during this block (5–7m)
- Integration checklist & responsibilities: Monica (CS) — run through mutual action plan
- Ops runbook & SLOs: Rishi Malhotra (on-call/ops esc) — provide incident response overview
- Next steps/action owners: Vanessa to capture and send follow-up doc (Kickoff_Agenda_v2.pdf)

Marcus — can you confirm capacity to present the infra diagram and a short demo of the dev->prod push (10–12m)? Naomi — can you confirm you'll cover the encryption/KMS and audit logs piece?

If all good I’ll update the agenda and Vanessa can send calendar invite with Meet link.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: Proposed kickoff windows + host assignments — Acme Retail onboarding

Thanks, all — finalizing. Calendar invite created and sent to attendees (link below). Meeting details:

When: Wed, Nov 10, 2027 — 11:00–12:30 PT / 14:00–15:30 ET
Where: Google Meet — https://meet.google.com/xyz-redwood-kickoff
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=acme-kickoff-20271115

Final attendee list (confirmed):
- Sarah Lee — Head of Platform (Acme)
- Rajesh Patel — Data Engineering (Acme)
- Elena Gomez — Security & Privacy (Acme)
- Paul Meyer — Product (tentative)
- Vanessa Ortiz — Customer Ops (Redwood) — chair
- Monica Patel — CS (Redwood) — MAP & next steps
- Marcus Lin — Infra/Integrations (Redwood) — architecture + demo
- Naomi Feldman — Enablement/Security (Redwood) — controls & audit logs
- Rishi Malhotra — Reliability (Redwood) — SLOs & incident flow

Attached is the finalized agenda and I uploaded a short pre-kickoff checklist to the shared drive (Kickoff_Agenda_v2.pdf). Please review the 3 prework items (API key access, sample data export, and pre-existing firewall rules) before the call.

If anyone needs to swap presenters or add a deeper deep-dive (e.g., manifest-level mapping), tell me by EOD Monday Nov 8 and I’ll adjust the send-out.

Thanks — calendar invite should arrive from me (vanessa@redwood.com).

—

vanessa@redwood.com
